body.statement: At every regular interior \(P\) in the observable target-indexed staggered-DDD model, \[\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}(O)=b^{\star}(X)^{\prime}\Psi_P(O)\] is the canonical gradient of \(\tau_{\omega}(P)\). Its variance is \[V_{\mathrm{eff}}=\operatorname{Var}_P\{\omega^{\prime}h(X)\}+E_P[b^{\star}(X)^{\prime}\Gamma_P(X)b^{\star}(X)],\] and every regular asymptotically linear estimator has asymptotic variance at least \(V_{\mathrm{eff}}\). This strictly tightens the OVS constant componentwise GMM benchmark whenever its pointwise projection equation fails.
body.justification: The result identifies the full observed-law information bound for a joint finite aggregate rather than the optimum inside a prespecified score span.
body.gap: Ortiz-Villavicencio and Sant'Anna (2025, Theorem 4.2 and Remark 4.6) establish asymptotic normality and optimize constant within-target GMM weights; Chen, Sant'Anna, and Xie (2025, Theorem 3.2) derive the optimal conditional efficient influence function and bound for staggered DiD, while their Theorem 4.1 proves attainment, but neither result contains the DDD-only full-data extension or coupled eligibility-gap tangent-exhaustion step.
body.consumer: Applied researchers obtain the correct precision benchmark and a principled reason to retain every admissible clean cohort.
